description: This PHP class 'Content' appears to handle content files within a documentation or static site generator framework. It manages loading content from files, parsing front matter (using the SymfonyYamlFrontMatter parser), navigating between previous and next content items, and retrieving metadata such as titles and attributes.

classes.name: Content
classes.description: A class representing a piece of content, capable of parsing front matter, managing links to adjacent content, and providing content metadata.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Content object with a parent directory, URI, and optional file info.

methods.name: getFrontMatter
methods.description: Parses the front matter from the content file or manually set content.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the content string, parsing attributes if needed.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets the content manually and flags it as manually set.

methods.name: isIndex
methods.description: Determines if this Content is the index based on URI.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Retrieves the title attribute or falls back to parent method.

methods.name: parseAttributes
methods.description: Parses front matter attributes from content.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a specific attribute or all attributes.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Returns a dump (array) representation of the content object, including previous/next URLs and attributes.
